SOURCES SOUGHT: THIS IS NOT A NOTICE OF REQUEST FOR QUOTATION BUT INFORMATION AND PLANNING PURPOSES ONLY.

This notice does not constitute a commitment by the Government. All information submitted in response to this announcement is voluntary and the Government will not pay for information requested nor will it compensate any respondent for any cost incurred in developing information provided to the Government.

Laughlin Air Force Base anticipates a requirement for a Fabrication T-38 Brake Riveter Rotary Table. Please see attachment for equipment specifications. 

Any interested firms should indicate capabilities and ability to support this requirement via email to the Contracting Officer/Specialist
